source_name: Universiteti i Prishtinës 'Hasan Prishtina' — Zyra e Prokurimit
why_relevant: Universities are meaningful banking-services buyers (student fee collection accounts, salary payment, POS on campus). UP's Procurement Office page is the entry point and its faculties publish separate tender invitations, meaning notices are scattered across faculty subsites rather than centralised.

source_name: Universiteti 'Ukshin Hoti' Prizren — Departamenti i Prokurimit
why_relevant: Confirms the pattern that Kosovo's regional public universities each host their own procurement department page and publish B08 award-notice PDFs directly. Small contract values but useful for mapping which banks serve which public institution.

source_name: Posta e Kosovës — Procurement / Prokurimi
why_relevant: Publicly-owned enterprise that is simultaneously a payments competitor and buyer (postal money transfer, bill payment counters, cash handling). Its own procurement publications page is a direct window on payment-infrastructure and cash-logistics tenders.

source_name: E-Prokurimi (KRPP central portal) — legislation & forms library
why_relevant: Not a substitute for the central portal itself (out of this cell), but its legislation library defines the standard forms (B05 contract notice, B08 award notice) and the publication thresholds — including that prior notices become mandatory for service contracts at/above EUR 500,000. That is the parsing schema and the filtering rule for every authority-level PDF collected in this cell. Serbian-language versions of the same instructions exist, confirming an official sr track.

source_name: VagonApp — Kosovo tender aggregator
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator surfacing Kosovo tenders (it was the route by which Trepça's current tenders were visible). Useful as a discovery layer to identify which contracting authorities are currently active, then go to those authorities' own sites for the fuller dossier.

source_name: Demokracia.com — procurement document leaks/annulments
why_relevant: Publishes underlying procurement documents alongside reporting (observed: a piece with source documents on the KEK procurement chief annulling a tender). Documents that authorities remove from their own sites sometimes survive only in this kind of reporting — a useful archival/reveals-indirectly source for the POE segment.

source_name: KEK — Korporata Energjetike e Kosovës (corporate site, procurement section)
why_relevant: Kosovo's largest POE by payroll and by consumer billing volume — a first-order buyer of bill-collection, POS and bank account services. Reporting confirms KEK runs its own procurement function issuing open-procedure contract notices, but the specific procurement URL on kek-energy.com was not located in this pass.

source_name: World Bank Projects & Operations — Procurement Notices search
why_relevant: Canonical publisher of General Procurement Notices, Specific Procurement Notices, REOIs and Contract Award Notices for all IDA/IBRD-financed operations in Kosovo, including the Financial Sector Development Project (P507881) that funds instant payments, deposit insurance and credit guarantee work. Notices never appear on Kosovo's national e-Prokurimi portal.

source_name: World Bank project page — Kosovo Financial Sector Development Project (P507881)
source_subtype: IFI project dossier (procurement plan + implementation status reports)
why_relevant: The single most relevant donor operation in this cell: USD 52m IDA credit approved 16 Jan 2025, implemented by the Central Bank of Kosovo, Deposit Insurance Fund (DIFK) and Kosovo Credit Guarantee Fund, explicitly to catalyse faster/instant payments and digital payment systems. Its procurement plan and ISRs pre-announce the pipeline of goods, IT-supply and consultancy contracts.

source_name: World Bank Group Finances One — Kosovo (contract awards dataset)
why_relevant: Structured, downloadable contract-award data (supplier name, country, amount, procurement category, project) for WB-financed contracts in Kosovo — the cleanest machine-readable view of who actually wins financial-sector and IT contracts.

source_name: EBRD Client e-Procurement Portal (ECEPP)
why_relevant: Since the migration, EBRD states that procurement, prequalification, shortlisting and contract award notices for EBRD loan/grant financed contracts are published ONLY on ECEPP. Any Kosovo public-sector EBRD project touching payments, financial infrastructure or FI digitalisation surfaces here first.

source_name: EBRD Procurement Notices (ebrd.com landing + corporate/consultancy notices)
why_relevant: Entry point that routes to ECEPP for project procurement and separately lists EBRD's own corporate and TC consultancy assignments; also carries country filters that reveal Kosovo activity. Useful as the stable pointer even as URLs migrate.

source_name: EBRD Kosovo news / project summary releases (financial-sector deals)
source_subtype: IFI press release / project summary document
why_relevant: EBRD financial-intermediary deals in Kosovo (e.g. Go Digital in the Western Balkans credit line to Banka për Biznes, EU-blended incentives) are private-sector operations that generate no public tender, but the news/project-summary stream reveals where automation and digitalisation money is flowing and which banks are counterparties.

source_name: UNDP Procurement Notices portal
why_relevant: UNDP Kosovo runs recurring consultancy and IT-supply procurements; confirmed relevant assignment types include banking-sector money-laundering risk assessment expertise. Notices are structured (negotiation id, country, deadline) and never enter the national portal.

source_name: United Nations Global Marketplace (UNGM) — public notices
why_relevant: Aggregates tender and award notices across 40+ UN organisations (UNDP, UNOPS, UNICEF, UNMIK, IOM) with Kosovo-tagged entries; the widest single net for UN-system procurement in the cell, including IT/consultancy contracts adjacent to financial services.

source_name: Millennium Foundation Kosovo (MFK) — Procurement
why_relevant: MFK administers the USD 202m MCC Compact (total budget up to USD 236.7m) under MCC Program Procurement Guidelines, publishing GPNs, Specific Procurement Notices (Njoftim Specifik për Prokurim) and a Bid Challenge System. Compact is energy-focused, but it procures large IT, financial-management, audit, banking and payment-agent services, and MFK is the template for how donor-rule procurement bypasses e-Prokurimi.

source_name: Crown Agents procurement notices (MFK/MCA-Kosovo procurement agent)
why_relevant: Donor programmes routinely outsource procurement execution to agents; Crown Agents publishes the MCA-Kosovo / MCC Kosovo GPNs and amendments on its own site. Procurement-agent sites are an under-watched parallel publication channel and often carry notices earlier or in fuller form than the principal.

source_name: GIZ Kosovo — Tenders
why_relevant: GIZ Office Kosovo tenders local and international expertise, including advisory work adjacent to financial-sector reform, SME finance and digitalisation. German cooperation procurement is entirely outside the national portal.

source_name: Regional Challenge Fund (KfW-financed) — Procurement in Kosovo
why_relevant: A concrete instance of KfW Financial Cooperation procurement rules applied to Kosovo: the Fund Management Unit publishes calls for tender, award notifications and procurement documentation under KfW Guidelines. Demonstrates the fund-management-unit pattern that also applies to KfW financial-sector and SME credit-line facilities.

source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal + TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) — IPA III Kosovo
source_subtype: supranational tender gazette with open API
why_relevant: IPA III assistance to Kosovo (first annual financing agreement EUR 63.96m; over EUR 138m across IPA 2019/2020; cumulative EU assistance above EUR 1.3bn) is procured under PRAG. Contract notices for works, goods and services under EU external action are published on the Funding & Tenders portal and TED, which offer structured data and an open API — the main machine-readable channel for EU-funded financial-sector and public-finance-management contracts in Kosovo.

source_name: EEAS — EU Office in Kosovo / EU Special Representative (sq, sr, en news and financing agreements)
why_relevant: Publishes IPA financing agreements and programme announcements in Albanian, Serbian and English, which pre-announce what will later be tendered. Trilingual output is the best single place to harvest local-language procurement and programme vocabulary for this cell.

source_name: EULEX Kosovo — Tenders
why_relevant: An EU mission procuring independently in Kosovo outside both the national portal and TED for lower-value contracts; relevant mainly for IT/security services and as an example of mission-level procurement channels that also exist for other international presences (UNMIK, OSCE, KFOR).

source_name: USAID Kosovo — Investment Promotion and Access to Finance Activity (grants/EOI notices)
why_relevant: A five-year activity whose implementing partner issues Expressions of Interest and Notices of Funding Opportunity (EUR 30k–230k) to banks, financial institutions and consultancies for access-to-finance and investment work; USAID has also co-convened bank/fintech access-to-finance events with the Central Bank. This is grant-side procurement that never touches e-Prokurimi.
